requirements.text: Prepare a conceptual documentation package for an assumed substation equipment replacement; do not select equipment ratings.
Identify required existing drawings and unknown engineering inputs before detailed design.
Provide a preliminary cost estimate, dependency-based schedule, and traceable review checklist.

approved_reference_notes.text: Demo project rule: mark every deliverable as a draft for engineer review.
Demo project rule: do not claim regulatory compliance or invent standards, equipment ratings, or field measurements.
